summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of Cash Run game. All 9 backend pytest tests pass and all 9 frontend Playwright checks pass. Backend leaderboard CRUD, validation, sort, limit, rank endpoint, and character defaulting all work. Frontend menu, character select, navigation to /play, canvas + HUD + theme label (Skid Row), keyboard movement (score increased 0 -> 110 after waiting 2.7s past READY), touch D-pad, pause toggle, How-to-play sections, and Leaderboard fetch all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Pydantic Field(min_length=1) on name is enforced before strip(); a name made of only spaces would pass validation but then fail with HTTPException 400 — minor consistency concern.

Frontend Game.jsx: handleRestart constructs a new engine but calls engineRef.current?.stop() AFTER assigning the new engine — old engine reference is lost before stop. Should stop old engine first, then create new one. Could cause leaked rAF loops on rapid restart.
Frontend api.js: no error handling/normalization in axios calls; Leaderboard page catches but submitScore/fetchRank do not. Acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Inserted test leaderboard rows with TEST_ prefix (TEST_A, TEST_B, TEST_C, TEST_R1, TEST_R2, TEST_INV) during pytest runs. Visible in Leaderboard screenshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 9 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_cashrun_api.py covering all leaderboard endpoints. Frontend critical flows verified via Playwright. Note: keyboard movement requires waiting ~2.6s past page navigation for the READY overlay to clear; clicking the canvas first to focus helps. Leaderboard now contains TEST_ seed entries that may be cleaned up if desired.
rca of the issue: No bugs found during this iteration.
